integrity: Proof and standalone finite checks supplied. Finite enumeration does not prove asymptotic results. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to involutive signed coordinate permutations on binary cube vertices only; no extension to arbitrary signed permutations or nonbinary alphabets. The exact fixed-point criterion and type B/D involution recurrences are established prior work; the assessed contribution is the conditional sharp asymptotics and Gaussian law. Historical priority cannot be guaranteed from the inspected material.
title: Sharp fixed-vertex rarity and conditional Gaussian geometry of signed involutions on binary cubes
